risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify beyond mega-cap AI; monitor antitrust lawsuit outcome and Trump AI czar policy; consider Keysight, Arm as less-concentrated AI plays

defensive_moves.recommendation: Diversify away from single-sector AI concentration

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from energy inflation, consumer stress, and geopolitical risk. Asian stocks edging higher on crude weakness offers brief relief, but diesel at $6.50 and Black Sea disruption cap upside. Expect elevated volatility into midterms. Gold and short Treasuries outperform equities.
market_outlook.long_term: AI structural growth intact but regulatory and concentration risks demand diversification. Energy transition and refinery capacity constraints support commodity prices for 12+ months. US debt trajectory and Buffett succession create uncertainty in capital allocation. EM healthcare and infrastructure offer asymmetric long-term returns.
